verification.method: Parent source inspection of current owner/caller paths and independent review hash verification; no new runtime exploit or production readback.
verification.changes: Evidence and existing release inventory only; no product fix or stage promotion.

findings.summary: Organization approval step capacity is not enforced in the locked decision owner.
findings.closure_required: Prove current per-step policy in the decision transaction, including denial when an Executive lacks the requested capacity.

findings.summary: Mounted legacy credential reset does not revoke preexisting refresh families or invalidate access sessions.
findings.closure_required: Prove atomic reset/session retirement and old access/refresh refusal; preserve native Account fences and historical custody bytes.

findings.summary: Legacy verify-only code redemption serializes but still mints an independent normal refresh family on each redemption.
findings.closure_required: Review a successor protocol and test contract before replacing the intentional replay expectation; prove exclusive redemption or restricted enrollment capability and interruption recovery.

findings.summary: Realtime connection registration and cursor replay task admission remain unbounded; idle sessions have no deadline.
findings.closure_required: Exercise per-subject/Company/process admission and bounded replay/lifetime recovery with current-authority rechecks; per-connection queue bounds alone do not close this finding.

findings.summary: HR and registry workbook parsing materializes dense ranges before business row limits; sparse coordinates can drive extreme allocation.
findings.closure_required: Reject excessive coordinates, cells, ZIP expansion/shared strings and sheet counts before dense materialization in every caller; demonstrate bounded memory without running an unbounded OOM payload.

findings.summary: Payroll has a locked natural-person decision guard; organization changes still compare only Account/User IDs. Native Account attribution and immutable person-history evidence remain open.
findings.closure_required: Preserve payroll guard and its existing 29-test evidence; prove organization and native Account same-person denial, unbound denial, concurrency and durable attribution.

findings.summary: Committed Traefik deployment omits trusted-proxy settings; runtime defaults to transport peer identity. Live topology/configuration is unverified.
findings.closure_required: Bind explicit trust settings to verified actual hop count and proxy CIDRs; prove distinct client buckets and forged/malformed-chain refusal through the deployment-equivalent proxy. Do not guess trusted networks.

findings.summary: Activation/deactivation use any-overlap read visibility before a Company-wide user mutation; complete target scope and privileged-target policy are not enforced by the owner.
findings.closure_required: Prove full target authority in the mutation transaction, including branch-A versus A+B and privileged targets; preserve Account credential fencing and lifecycle replay.

findings.summary: Ordinary tenant resolution now checks active status and live roles; token generation comparison and precise alternate-context closure remain unproven.
findings.closure_required: Prove deactivation/reactivation, generation mismatch and downgrade histories across each reachable tenant/group/platform/realtime owner. Group grants already check active state and some platform owners already revalidate original credentials; do not claim blanket exploitation.

limits: This partial scan is not security qualification of the assembled release.
Reported severities are retained from the scan, not newly measured deployment risk.
No historical migrations, custody fingerprints, command bytes or tests are changed.
No exposure, payment execution or production credential-reset authority is granted.
